Navs and tabs

A row of links between views of one thing — nav-underline — or of choices — nav-pills; and the same row as tabs that switch panels on the page, driven by the keyboard as the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern.

Examples

Links between pages are a <nav>; the current one is aria-current="page".

All28 Needs attention3 Drafts
Week Month Year 
<nav class="nav nav-underline" aria-label="List views">
	<a class="nav-link" href="#nav-links" aria-current="page">All<span class="badge">28</span></a>
	<a class="nav-link" href="#nav-links">Needs attention<span class="badge badge-subtle-warning">3</span></a>
	<a class="nav-link" href="#nav-links">Drafts</a>
</nav>
<nav class="nav nav-pills" aria-label="Period">
	<a class="nav-link" href="#nav-links" aria-current="page">Week</a>
	<a class="nav-link" href="#nav-links">Month</a>
	<a class="nav-link" href="#nav-links">Year</a>
</nav>

Tabs

Tabs switch panels in place: role="tablist", each tab role="tab" with aria-selected and aria-controls, each panel role="tabpanel". The library keeps only the selected tab in the tab order and only its panel shown. The arrow keys select as they move.

A day at sea: snorkelling at two reefs, lunch on the boat.

Adults 2,500 · children 1,900 · under four free.

Edited yesterday by M. K.; published on three sites.

<div class="nav nav-underline" role="tablist" aria-label="Excursion">
	<button class="nav-link" type="button" role="tab" id="nav-tabs-1" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="nav-tabs-panel-1">Details</button>
	<button class="nav-link" type="button" role="tab" id="nav-tabs-2" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="nav-tabs-panel-2">Prices</button>
	<button class="nav-link" type="button" role="tab" id="nav-tabs-3" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="nav-tabs-panel-3">History</button>
</div>
<div id="nav-tabs-panel-1" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="nav-tabs-1" tabindex="0"><p>A day at sea: snorkelling at two reefs, lunch on the boat.</p></div>
<div id="nav-tabs-panel-2" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="nav-tabs-2" tabindex="0" hidden><p>Adults 2,500 · children 1,900 · under four free.</p></div>
<div id="nav-tabs-panel-3" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="nav-tabs-3" tabindex="0" hidden><p>Edited yesterday by M. K.; published on three sites.</p></div>

Tabs whose panels load

When a panel comes from the server, the arrows should not load every panel they pass: data-activation="manual" on the tablist makes them move the focus only, and Enter or Space selects.

128 bookings this week.

312,400 THB this week.

2 refunds this week.

<div class="nav nav-pills" role="tablist" aria-label="Report" data-activation="manual">
	<button class="nav-link" type="button" role="tab" id="nav-manual-1" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="nav-manual-panel-1">Bookings</button>
	<button class="nav-link" type="button" role="tab" id="nav-manual-2" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="nav-manual-panel-2">Revenue</button>
	<button class="nav-link" type="button" role="tab" id="nav-manual-3" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="nav-manual-panel-3">Refunds</button>
</div>
<div id="nav-manual-panel-1" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="nav-manual-1" tabindex="0"><p>128 bookings this week.</p></div>
<div id="nav-manual-panel-2" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="nav-manual-2" tabindex="0" hidden><p>312,400 THB this week.</p></div>
<div id="nav-manual-panel-3" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="nav-manual-3" tabindex="0" hidden><p>2 refunds this week.</p></div>

Filling the width

nav-fill lets the links share the width by their length, nav-justified in equal parts.

Overview Prices and seasons Reviews
Overview Prices and seasons Reviews 
<nav class="nav nav-underline nav-fill" aria-label="Filled">
	<a class="nav-link" href="#nav-fill" aria-current="page">Overview</a>
	<a class="nav-link" href="#nav-fill">Prices and seasons</a>
	<a class="nav-link" href="#nav-fill">Reviews</a>
</nav>
<nav class="nav nav-underline nav-justified" aria-label="Justified">
	<a class="nav-link" href="#nav-fill" aria-current="page">Overview</a>
	<a class="nav-link" href="#nav-fill">Prices and seasons</a>
	<a class="nav-link" href="#nav-fill">Reviews</a>
</nav>

Where you are on the page

A nav or a list group with data-scrollspy marks the link to the section in view aria-current="location" as the page — or the box the sections scroll in — scrolls: the last section whose top has passed a quarter of the height, or the last one at the end.

Plan The boat Lunch Back

Plan

Pick-up at the hotel at 7:30, the pier at 8:15. The crew hands out life vests and snorkels before the boat leaves the bay.

The boat

A speedboat for 30 guests with shade and a toilet; the ride to the park takes an hour across open water.

Lunch

Thai lunch on a beach of the park: rice, green curry, fruit and water; vegetarian on request.

Back

The boat leaves the park at 15:30 and reaches the pier by 17:00; the transfer brings everyone back to the hotel.

<div class="grid md:cols-12 gap-16">
	<nav class="list-group list-group-flush md:span-4" aria-label="On this example" data-scrollspy>
		<a class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" href="#nav-spy-plan">Plan</a>
		<a class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" href="#nav-spy-boat">The boat</a>
		<a class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" href="#nav-spy-lunch">Lunch</a>
		<a class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" href="#nav-spy-back">Back</a>
	</nav>
	<div class="docs-scroll md:span-8 vstack gap-16" tabindex="0" role="region" aria-label="The day, by section">
		<section id="nav-spy-plan" class="vstack gap-4"><h4 class="fs-14">Plan</h4><p class="mb-0">Pick-up at the hotel at 7:30, the pier at 8:15. The crew hands out life vests and snorkels before the boat leaves the bay.</p></section>
		<section id="nav-spy-boat" class="vstack gap-4"><h4 class="fs-14">The boat</h4><p class="mb-0">A speedboat for 30 guests with shade and a toilet; the ride to the park takes an hour across open water.</p></section>
		<section id="nav-spy-lunch" class="vstack gap-4"><h4 class="fs-14">Lunch</h4><p class="mb-0">Thai lunch on a beach of the park: rice, green curry, fruit and water; vegetarian on request.</p></section>
		<section id="nav-spy-back" class="vstack gap-4"><h4 class="fs-14">Back</h4><p class="mb-0">The boat leaves the park at 15:30 and reaches the pier by 17:00; the transfer brings everyone back to the hotel.</p></section>
	</div>
</div>

Keyboard and accessibility

KeyIn a tablist
→ / ←The next / the previous tab, round the ends — mirrored right to left; ↓ / ↑ in a list with aria-orientation="vertical"
Home / EndThe first / the last tab
Enter, SpaceSelects the focused tab — what the arrows do not, with data-activation="manual"
TabFrom the selected tab into its panel
  • Links that change the page are a <nav> of links, never tabs: tabs only switch what is already on the page.
  • A mark beside a tab's words — a dot, a count — has its own name, so the tab reads as “EN, 1 field outdated”.

From css/components/nav.css, which declares no custom property of its own.
